title: The homogeneous ideal generated by the homogeneous elements of a prime is prime
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a graded ring S and a prime p, the lemma states that the ideal q generated by the homogeneous elements of p is again prime (statement lines 13867-13874). The proof does not study the graded structure of p or compare components: it reduces primality to the case of a product of two homogeneous elements, uses that q is generated by homogeneous elements of p to place the product in p, applies primality there, and then upgrades membership in p of a homogeneous element to membership in q (proof lines 13876-13884). The two passage steps, both resting on homogeneity, are what the argument turns on. H2.
